svg.title: Project 4 Part 3 - CANopen Architecture with Zephyr tasks

g.text: Project 4 Part 3 - CANopen Architecture with Zephyr tasks
Changed from Part 2: the superloop is split into tasks.
Frames are only sent from the work queue, never from
the control thread (can_send can block up to 10 ms).
MotorApp locks app_mutex for every access from
the CAN thread and the work queue.
